Creamy garlic chicken 🍗🔥 you NEED to try this!! #dinner #easyrecipes #fyp
Follow me @someone for more easy dinners ❤️

Serves 4 · ready in 30 min

Ingredients:
• 500 g chicken thighs
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 cup heavy cream
• 1 tsp paprika

Method:
1. Fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
2. Add the garlic and paprika, then the cream.
3. Simmer 10 minutes and serve.

Title: Best Banana Bread
Home
Recipes
About

Best Banana Bread
By Example Kitchen
Prep time: 10 minutes
Cook time: 55 minutes
Serves 10
This banana bread is moist and easy. It has been a family favourite for years.
Ingredients
- 3 ripe bananas
- 1/3 cup melted butter
- 3/4 cup sugar
- 1 1/2 cups flour
Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. Mash the bananas and mix everything.
3. Bake for 55 minutes.
Notes
Keeps 3 days.
